milestones.label: Final selection results communicated
milestones.time_text: From the second half of November 2026
milestones.source_text: The AGCID call for 2027 (official, May 2026) says final selection results will be communicated from the second half of November 2026. Country focal points must enter shortlisted candidates on the AGCID platform by 30 October 2026, 23:59 Chile time. No 2027 results were on AGCID's results page when checked.
